AdditionalInformation.name: Additional Information
AdditionalInformation.definition: Provides additional information regarding the party, for example, the contact unit or person responsible for the transaction identified in the message.

SafekeepingAccount.name: Safekeeping Account
SafekeepingAccount.definition: Account to or from which a securities entry is made.

AdditionalInforrmationRule.definition: The AdditionalInformation field in all elements must not contain information that can be provided in a structured field unless bilaterally agreed or advised differently in the element definition as in NarrativeVersion.
